subject.title: [Feature]: 3 architecture improvements — bootstrap relevance, incremental compaction, observation extraction

question: Which part of this broad architecture request should OpenClaw core own first, and which parts should move to existing plugin/context-engine trackers?
rationale: Current main partially addresses AGENTS.md bootstrap relevance and has plugin/context-engine compaction surfaces, but choosing a generic relevance algorithm or promoting observation extraction into core is a product/architecture boundary decision.

options.title: Split Into Tracks
options.body: Create or confirm separate focused trackers for bootstrap relevance, compaction architecture, and observation extraction, then close or repurpose this broad umbrella after links are in place.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella
options.body: Use this issue only as a parent architecture discussion and block automated repair work until maintainers prioritize one track.

options.title: Supersede After Relinking
options.body: Close this issue once maintainers confirm the bootstrap and compaction work are fully covered by narrower open items and observation extraction belongs outside core.

recommendation.title: Split Into Tracks
recommendation.body: Create or confirm separate focused trackers for bootstrap relevance, compaction architecture, and observation extraction, then close or repurpose this broad umbrella after links are in place.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already gave the maintainer-style review on this issue and has recent history on the affected bootstrap/runtime paths.
